rationale: The workflow is a cache-cleanup/maintenance workflow (cache-cleanup.yml) with no build or test steps and no dependency installation. The candidate P-LIT-GHA-CACHE (cache dependency downloads) requires repeated dependency fetching with lockfile-keyed cache inputs, which this workflow does not perform—it only runs pre-installed `gh cache list/delete` commands, so adding a dependency cache would be unrelated and would not preserve or affect any intended coverage. P-LIT-IDLE-SCHEDULE is contraindicated because the scheduled daily run performs time-based cache eviction (2-day staleness cutoff and closed-PR sweeps) that must run regardless of repository activity, matching the contraindication that time-based requirements need fresh checks. P-LIT-CANCEL-STALE, P-LIT-SKIP-WORKFLOW, P-LIT-CHANGE-FILTER, P-LIT-FAIL-SCHEDULE, and P-LIT-CUSTOM-TIMEOUT do not fit a single-job cleanup workflow with no matrix, no repeated revisions, no required-status contract to relax, no demonstrated runaway consumption, and no failing-schedule history. No supported optimization's preconditions are met without introducing unrelated changes or weakening the workflow's intended cache-eviction behavior.
